{{Quote|But we've still lost the lateral controls for the starboard deflector shield!|Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 5">[[Star Wars (1977) 5|''Star Wars'' (1977) 5]]</ref>}}
'''Lateral controls''' refer to any controls which manipulate direction, whether of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], or of individual starship components such as [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] on ships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} starboard deflector shield's lateral controls were lost when the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was attacked by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] while fleeing the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] lost lateral controls during a malfunction over [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], forcing her to crash-land on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
